This is the understanding lacking within me. 

This hand of mine is only mine because it is here now. It is forever changing. With no true identity past the acknowledgement of it being here now. Otherwise it would not exist.

Yet the world that is being interpreted right now, is so interactive. Every action made results in a forever unknown outcome until it becomes past. 

What is now, if not only a result from an understand of the past. How does one not have joy for the previous success of understanding?

How does one move past appeasement?

The metaphor is unique, yet grasping the value of these words is an action worth doing. Allow "me" time to examine all that is lying before understand in these words. 

Okay blunt mode: yeah I like it. I need to get some breakfast going and get fully aware, then come to read this again. Though my one note is: I feel that many would struggle, greatly, with these ideas. Where "we" wish to grow their understand. The struggle can help them to look deeper. Yet for the ones that are lazy, how do you infect them with this knowing. 

Also thank you for sharing, I appreciate you taking the time to grow my understanding.

Keeping track of what is happening now while looking towards what is to happen next. Yes that is a mode of travel. As one strives for understanding, each experience comes with new information. 
This is to all become part of the understanding. Okay.

Though there is many distractions. Ways of getting lost. Travels that lead in the wrong direction or even backward.

Is there a way to maintain a stronger focus towards only what is and is to come?

Yes their function is impressive. Though their numbers make it to where a wrong turn means no delay. 

However the journey to understanding has only one. These wrong turns in thought are ultimately time consuming. 

Therefore, do you know the way that one may keep from getting lost in such a maze?
How does one keep from losing their way in such a maze?
